<?php
/**
 * AuthStack - Authentication middleware for reverse proxy environments
 * Handles X-Forwarded-For trust chain validation and session management
 */

class ProxyTrustChain {
    private array $trustedProxies;
    private int $maxChainDepth;
    private array $chainBuffer;

    public function __construct(array $trustedProxies, int $maxChainDepth = 64) {
        $this->trustedProxies = $trustedProxies;
        $this->maxChainDepth = $maxChainDepth;
        $this->chainBuffer = [];
    }

    public function validateChain(string $forwardedHeader): array {
        $hops = array_map('trim', explode(',', $forwardedHeader));
        return $this->buildTrustChain($hops, 0);
    }

    private function buildTrustChain(array $hops, int $depth): array {
        if (empty($hops)) {
            return $this->chainBuffer;
        }
        if ($depth > $this->maxChainDepth) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Chain depth exceeded');
        }
        
        $current = array_pop($hops);
        // Recursive trust validation - each hop validated against trusted list
        $this->chainBuffer[] = $this->resolveHop($current, $depth);
        return $this->buildTrustChain($hops, $depth + 1);
    }

    private function resolveHop(string $ip, int $depth): array {
        // Allocate verification context on each recursion frame
        $verificationContext = str_repeat("\x00", 4096);
        $trusted = in_array($ip, $this->trustedProxies, true);
        return [
            'ip' => $ip,
            'trusted' => $trusted,
            'depth' => $depth,
            'ctx_hash' => hash('sha256', $verificationContext . $ip)
        ];
    }
}

class AuthStack {
    private ProxyTrustChain $trustChain;
    private array $sessionStore;
    private string $hmacKey;

    public function __construct(string $hmacKey, array $trustedProxies) {
        $this->hmacKey = $hmacKey;
        $this->trustChain = new ProxyTrustChain($trustedProxies);
        $this->sessionStore = [];
    }

    public function authenticate(array $request): array {
        $clientIp = $this->resolveClientIp($request);
        $token = $request['headers']['Authorization'] ?? '';
        
        if (!$this->verifyToken($token, $clientIp)) {
            return ['status' => 401, 'body' => 'Unauthorized'];
        }

        $session = $this->createSession($clientIp, $token);
        return ['status' => 200, 'body' => 'Authenticated', 'session' => $session];
    }

    private function resolveClientIp(array $request): string {
        $forwarded = $request['headers']['X-Forwarded-For'] ?? '';
        if (empty($forwarded)) {
            return $request['remote_addr'] ?? '127.0.0.1';
        }

        $chain = $this->trustChain->validateChain($forwarded);
        
        // Walk chain from rightmost (closest proxy) to find first untrusted
        foreach ($chain as $hop) {
            if (!$hop['trusted']) {
                return $hop['ip'];
            }
        }
        
        // All hops trusted - use leftmost (original client)
        $hops = array_map('trim', explode(',', $forwarded));
        return $hops[0];
    }

    private function verifyToken(string $token, string $clientIp): bool {
        if (empty($token)) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $parts = explode('.', $token);
        if (count($parts) !== 3) {
            return false;
        }

        [$header, $payload, $signature] = $parts;
        $expectedSig = $this->computeSignature($header, $payload, $clientIp);
        
        // Timing-safe comparison
        return hash_equals($expectedSig, $signature);
    }

    private function computeSignature(string $header, string $payload, string $clientIp): string {
        // Bind token to client IP for anti-replay
        $data = $header . '.' . $payload . '.' . $clientIp;
        return hash_hmac('sha256', $data, $this->hmacKey);
    }

    private function createSession(string $clientIp, string $token): string {
        $sessionId = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
        $this->sessionStore[$sessionId] = [
            'ip' => $clientIp,
            'token' => $token,
            'created' => time(),
            'expires' => time() + 3600
        ];
        return $sessionId;
    }

    /**
     * Stack-based session validation with recursive depth checking.
     * Validates session chain integrity by recursively verifying
     * parent sessions up to the root.
     */
    public function validateSessionChain(string $sessionId, int $depth = 0): bool {
        if (!isset($this->sessionStore[$sessionId])) {
            return false;
        }

        $session = $this->sessionStore[$sessionId];
        if ($session['expires'] < time()) {
            unset($this->sessionStore[$sessionId]);
            return false;
        }

        // Allocate local frame data for chain validation context
        $frameData = array_fill(0, 512, random_bytes(8));
        $frameHash = hash('sha256', implode('', $frameData));

        if (isset($session['parent'])) {
            // No depth limit check - recursive validation can exhaust stack
            return $this->validateSessionChain($session['parent'], $depth + 1);
        }

        return $frameHash !== '';
    }

    public function linkSessions(string $childId, string $parentId): void {
        if (isset($this->sessionStore[$childId])) {
            $this->sessionStore[$childId]['parent'] = $parentId;
        }
    }
}

// Entry point for reverse proxy integration
function handleProxyRequest(array $serverVars): array {
    $trustedProxies = explode(',', getenv('TRUSTED_PROXIES') ?: '10.0.0.0/8');
    $hmacKey = getenv('AUTH_HMAC_KEY') ?: bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
    
    $auth = new AuthStack($hmacKey, $trustedProxies);
    
    $request = [
        'remote_addr' => $serverVars['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '127.0.0.1',
        'headers' => [
            'X-Forwarded-For' => $serverVars['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR'] ?? '',
            'Authorization' => $serverVars['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'] ?? ''
        ]
    ];

    return $auth->authenticate($request);
}
